definitions.explanation: A decorative arrangement of cut flowers tied or wrapped together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{花束|はなたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave her a bouquet of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{花束|はなたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a bouquet at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: {花束|はなたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you make a bouquet for me?
